IGUI_PD_PauseGrowthTip: Dogs that never grow up? Wish real life had that toggle :D
IGUI_PD_NeedFood: You need food in your inventory.
IGUI_PD_NeedWater: You need water in your inventory.
IGUI_PD_HealthDeathDisabled: Illness and neglect do not kill the pet (sandbox option).
IGUI_PD_KeepDesc: How far behind you the %1 follows.
IGUI_PD_ReleaseWarn: It stops being yours. To get it back you have to find it again out in the world.
IGUI_PD_Dismissed: %1 is no longer your active companion.
IGUI_PD_DismissTip: The %1 stays where it is and goes back to being a passive pet. No dog will be active until you select one.
IGUI_PD_NotYourDog: This %1 already belongs to someone else.
IGUI_PD_DrivingDisabledTip: Not available while driving, your companion is riding with you.
IGUI_PD_Sick: The %1 gets sick from the bad food.
IGUI_PD_Weak: The %1 is weak from going too long without meat.
IGUI_PD_BadFood: Bad for dogs. Eating this makes the pet sick.
IGUI_PD_WoundedCritical: The %1 is badly wounded, it will only follow until it heals.
IGUI_PD_PanicWarn: The %1 is panicking, it won't fight.
IGUI_PD_PetCooldown: The %1 has had enough affection for now.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_BreedHappy_desc: The Caramelo is a wonderfully affectionate, charismatic mutt. Its loyal company lifts your spirits, so sadness and boredom fade faster while it's near.
IGUI_PD_Refused_disloyal: %1 doesn't trust you and ignores the command.
IGUI_PD_Refused_wounded: %1 is too badly hurt to fight.
IGUI_PD_NoTarget: Your %1 finds nothing it can reach to attack.
IGUI_PD_AlertGroup: Your %1 barks! A group of zombies!
IGUI_PD_AlertFar: Your %1 catches a zombie's scent far off
IGUI_PD_ResetSpawnsTip: Resets Companion spawns across the world, new dogs will appear in areas you already visited.
IGUI_PD_SkillDesc_scent: The %1's nose. A higher Scent senses zombies from farther away.
IGUI_PD_SkillDesc_combat: Fighting prowess. More damage and less panic while fighting.
IGUI_PD_SkillDesc_obedience: Less chance of refusing a command, and learns new tricks.
IGUI_PD_ScanTooFar: Too far away. Get closer to inspect it.
IGUI_PD_ScanTrustDesc: How close this %1 is to trusting you enough to come along. Feeding it is what builds this up; bad food tears it down.
IGUI_PD_LoyaltyDesc: How much the %1 trusts you. It slowly fades over time, faster while it's hungry or thirsty, and is restored by feeding, giving water and petting. If it drops too low the %1 turns disobedient.
IGUI_PD_NeedDesc_hunger: Hunger throttles healing: a fed %1 recovers wounds faster. Hunger can kill your pet and makes loyalty drop faster.
IGUI_PD_NeedDesc_thirst: Like hunger, thirst throttles natural healing. Severe thirst can kill your pet and makes loyalty drop faster.
IGUI_PD_NeedDesc_health: The %1's life. Health only falls from hunger, thirst and poisoning, and recovers slowly while well cared for.
IGUI_PD_NeedDesc_stress: Builds from hunger, thirst, low loyalty and FIGHTING: every strike stresses the %1. If it peaks into panic it won't fight, it only follows. How much it gains depends on the animal's genes and breed.
IGUI_PD_GenomeDesc: Genes vary from one animal to the next, even within the same breed. They never go up.
IGUI_PD_GeneDesc_aggressiveness: Higher Aggressiveness earns combat XP faster.
IGUI_PD_GeneDesc_resistance: Higher Resistance lets it fight longer, get hurt less and panic less.
IGUI_PD_CmdStayDesc: The %1 holds its position and won't follow.
IGUI_PD_CmdGuardDesc: The %1 stands guard in place and attacks nearby zombies.
IGUI_PD_AlertFullDesc: Smells zombies from afar, but barks loudly to warn you, which can draw distant zombies.
IGUI_PD_AlertQuietDesc: Smells nearby zombies, but doesn't draw them to you.
IGUI_PD_AutoProtectDesc: Stands guard and protects you while you do things like reading, building, eating, etc.
IGUI_PD_BreedDesc_caramelo: The most basic breed in the game, not good at anything in particular and can't kill zombies, but very charismatic.
IGUI_PD_CmdFetchDesc: Whistle for the %1 to come right away, your whistle can draw zombies.
IGUI_PD_BtnRenameDesc: Give your companion a custom name.
IGUI_PD_BtnReleaseDesc: Sends your companion away. It keeps its training and skills, so you can tame it again later if you find it.
IGUI_PD_BreedDesc_germanshepherd: A strong, intelligent dog. Learns Combat and Obedience quickly and gains little stress in a fight. Rare: found around police and military buildings.
IGUI_PD_BreedDesc_retriever: A friendly, keen-nosed gun dog, learns Hunting faster, average fighter. Its nose helps you forage and track game from farther away. Uncommon: turns up now and then in residential houses.
IGUI_PD_BreedDesc_bordercollie: An intelligent herding dog. Buff for tending farm animals, but an average fighter. Stray Border Collies turn up around barns and farmsteads out in the countryside.
IGUI_PD_BreedDesc_husky: A hardy sled dog, by far the breed with the most raw strength, saddlebag weight buff and keeps you warm in the cold. Average fighter. Stubborn (slower to learn Obedience), gets hungry and thirsty faster. Rare: found mostly in the cold of winter, and at pet shops and vets.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_GSCourage_desc: A bold German Shepherd at your side steadies your nerves. Its fearless presence eases your panic while it stays close.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_GoldenNose_desc: Your Golden Retriever helps you hunt. When well cared for, you spot forage from farther away and learn Foraging, Trapping and Aiming faster.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_Warmed_desc: Your husky pulls its weight at your side. Well cared for, it builds your Strength faster and helps you tire less. It's a warm dog, it keeps you warm in the cold.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_CollieHerding_desc: Your border collie helps you with farm animals. Well cared for, the animals around you settle down, and you learn Animal Care and Farming faster.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_Sick_desc: You fed it something animals shouldn't eat. Your pet is intoxicated and feeling ill.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_Weak_desc: Your pet is weak, it deals less damage and obeys less, give it food with protein.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_Rested_desc: You slept soundly with your pet at your side. For a while: panic, stress, sadness and boredom fade faster, and you tire more slowly.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_Grief_desc: Your pet is gone. The grief weighs on you, and it will only fade with time.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_Grief_desc_named: %1 is gone. The grief weighs on you, and it will only fade with time.
IGUI_PD_DishNoSpace: No room to place the dish here.
IGUI_PD_DishFull: The bowl doesn't have room for all of that.
IGUI_PD_DishGone: The dish is no longer there.
IGUI_PD_DishNoWater: You need water to fill it.
IGUI_PD_BowlNeedFood: You have no food to add.
IGUI_PD_BowlHasWater: The bowl has water. Empty it to add food.
IGUI_PD_BowlHasFood: The bowl has food. Empty it to add water.
IGUI_PD_KeyJoypadNote: Controller: hold D-pad down for the dog radial; the Back button wheel opens this window.
IGUI_PD_SkillDesc_hunt: Levels up by pointing game and foraging. 0: points animals and sniffs out frogs/bugs (you need to look with Search Mode). 3: takes small game (rabbit, raccoon). 6: takes on deer and brings the kill back.
IGUI_PD_HuntModeDesc: The %1 enters hunt mode, what it does depends on its Hunting level (see the skill).
IGUI_PD_HuntDisabledTip: Hunting is turned off on this server.
IGUI_PD_HuntDelivered: The %1 brought its kill to you.
IGUI_PD_HuntWoundedDeer: The %1 wounded a deer, you need to kill it!
IGUI_PD_HuntTrackWounded: The %1 is tracking the wounded game...
IGUI_PD_ForageFound: The %1 found something! Turn on Search Mode to see it.
IGUI_PD_BagLive: Take the live animal out of the saddlebags first.
IGUI_PD_BagMapNoAnnot: Map markings aren't kept in the saddlebag.
IGUI_PD_KennelStatusNoData: Pet despawned, try to find it to register it
IGUI_PD_KennelRecallConfirm: Call %1 back? Your loud whistle will draw zombies.
IGUI_PD_Refused_invehicle: %1 is riding in your vehicle, it comes back when you get out.
IGUI_PD_Refused_carried: %1 is in your arms, just put it down.
IGUI_PD_Refused_nodata: There is no record of that pet to call it back.
IGUI_PD_DogLost: %1 has gone missing! Open My Companions (paw button) > My Pets to call it back.
IGUI_PD_Refused_recallcd: %1 was called recently, wait a while before calling again.
IGUI_PD_CareModeDesc: When on, the %1 stays in this zone, keeps the animals calm to protect their production, and kills nearby zombies. Protects the chickens at night.
IGUI_PD_CareOnMsg: %1 will care for the animals here.
IGUI_PD_CareOffMsg: %1 will stop caring for the animals.
IGUI_PD_CareNoPen: %1 needs a designated animal zone here to care for them.
IGUI_PD_CareAlertZombie: %1 senses a zombie near the animal zone!
IGUI_PD_CareCoopShut: %1 looked after the coop for the night.
IGUI_PD_CareCoopOpen: %1 opened the coop for the day.
IGUI_PD_CareDeselectConfirm: Assign %1 to care for the animals here?
IGUI_PD_SkillDesc_herding: Skill at tending livestock. Levels up by caring for the animals in the zone, and gains more XP by killing zombies in it. The higher it is, the more it calms the animals.
IGUI_PD_TrickLockedHalo: %1 does not know that trick yet (Obedience %2)
IGUI_PD_TrickCooldown: %1 just did that, give it a moment
IGUI_PD_TrickGotoDesc: Send the pet to a chosen tile and have it hold there.
IGUI_PD_TrickDistractDesc: The pet draws attention on purpose to pull zombies toward itself. It costs stress, and the horde goes for the pet.
IGUI_PD_TrickSniffDesc: Hold an item and the pet memorizes its scent. From then on it warns you and goes to it whenever one is nearby.
IGUI_PD_TrickFetch: Fetch an item while you sleep
IGUI_PD_TrickFetchDesc: Hold an item and the pet memorizes it. Every time you sleep it goes out looking on its own and can come back with one, stowed in the saddlebags. Once a day, and the rarer the item the longer it takes. Needs saddlebags.
IGUI_PD_TrickGotoPick: Click where to send the pet. Right click cancels.
IGUI_PD_TrickGotoBad: %1 cannot be sent to that spot
IGUI_PD_TrickSniffNoItem: Hold the item you want the pet to smell.
IGUI_PD_TrickFetchNoItem: Hold the item you want the pet to look for.
IGUI_PD_TrickFetchStopDesc: It will no longer look for the item.
IGUI_PD_TrickSniffStopDesc: Forgets the memorized scent and stops warning you about it.
IGUI_PD_TrickFetchArmed: %1 will look for %2 while you sleep.
IGUI_PD_TrickFetchUnknown: %1 would not know where to look for %2.
IGUI_PD_WarnOldSave: Companion Dogs was enabled on a save that already existed.\nEverything works normally. Stray dogs are placed as you travel and parts of the map load in, so they show up in areas you have already explored as well as in new ones.\nTravel around a little and you will start finding them.
IGUI_PD_WarnRigMissing: Companion Dogs could not load the dog animations.\nThis happens when the mod was not enabled in the main menu, and the dogs will render deformed.\nQuit to the main menu, make sure Companion Dogs is enabled there, then load your save again.
IGUI_PD_VetInfected: The %1's wound got infected. It won't heal until treated.
IGUI_PD_VetNothing: The %1 has no wound to treat.
IGUI_PD_VetNeedSterile: An infected wound needs a sterile bandage or a disinfectant.
IGUI_PD_VetNeedCalm: The %1 won't hold still. Pet it first.
IGUI_PD_NeedBandage: You need a bandage or ripped sheets in your inventory.
IGUI_PD_VetTodo_cut: Bandage it. A sterile bandage or a disinfectant keeps infection away, and rest heals it faster.
IGUI_PD_VetTodo_infected: It clears on its own in 2 days. Companion Dogs antibiotics cut that to 12 h, human ones to 24 h.
IGUI_PD_VetPaused: Recovery paused while stored in the kennel.
IGUI_PD_VetTodo_fracture: It takes longer than a wound and needs a dressing too.
IGUI_PD_VetSymptom_fever: Running hot, needs to drink more water.
IGUI_PD_VetSymptom_gastro: Gets hungry and thirsty twice as fast.
IGUI_PD_VetTodo_sprain: It passes in a day while it keeps moving, faster if it rests.
IGUI_PD_VetTodo_gastro: Keep the water coming, it passes with time. Grass speeds the recovery up.
IGUI_PD_VetTodo_worms: It needs a dewormer, it never clears on its own.
IGUI_PD_VetRowTip_immune: Wounds do not get infected and spoiled food or stale water do not upset the stomach while the vaccine lasts.
IGUI_PD_VetRowTip_serum: The serum holds the infection back for a day. It does not cure anything.
IGUI_PD_VetFever: %1 has a fever. The infection is getting worse.
IGUI_PD_VetCritical: %1 is critical and needs antibiotics fast!
IGUI_PD_VetDying: %1 is dying. Antibiotics now, or serum to buy time.
IGUI_PD_VetRowTip_deworm: The dewormer clears the parasites a few hours in, and keeps new ones away for 30 days.
IGUI_PD_VetGrass: %1 chewed the grass and feels a bit better.
IGUI_PD_VetAbxWeak: %1 took the antibiotics, but they did not take.
IGUI_PD_VetAbxFailed: The antibiotics were not enough for %1. Try another dose.
IGUI_PD_VetAbxLate: Human antibiotics are too weak for %1 now. It needs veterinary antibiotics.
IGUI_PD_VetNoNeed: %1 does not need that right now.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_Dewormed_desc: Protected from intestinal parasites for %1 more days.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_ProtHeartworm_desc: Protected from heartworm for %1 more days.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_ProtFlea_desc: Protected from fleas and ticks for %1 more days.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_ProtAllergy_desc: Protected from skin allergy for %1 more days.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_Immune_desc: Your pet is vaccinated: wounds do not get infected and its stomach is protected.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_Boost_desc: Protected from infection, upset stomach and flu for %1 more hours.
IGUI_PD_VetAbxHuman: %1 took the human antibiotics, they are not as effective.
IGUI_PD_Tip_RawOil: Raw, cook it for 30 minutes to get Rose Geranium Oil.
IGUI_PD_Tip_RawSyrup: Raw, cook it for 30 minutes to get Elderberry Syrup.
IGUI_PD_Tip_GeraniumOil: Made by cooking Raw Rose Geranium Oil on the stove for 30 minutes.
IGUI_PD_RecipeTip_CookAfter: Comes out raw, cook it for 30 minutes on a lit stove.
IGUI_PD_RecipeTip_NeedsOil: Cook the oil for 30 minutes to finish it.
IGUI_PD_VetRowTip_prev: Nothing new takes hold while the protection lasts.
IGUI_PD_VetRowTip_aid: A home remedy is helping. It wears off on its own; a splint stays until the bone heals.
IGUI_PD_VetBathNeed: You need 1 L of water in a container and a rag, towel or sponge.
IGUI_PD_VetTweezers: Pick off fleas and ticks with tweezers
IGUI_PD_VetTweezersDone: You picked the fleas and ticks off %1. They come back in about 6 hours unless the dog gets medicine or repellent.
IGUI_PD_VetRow_picked: Fleas and ticks picked off with tweezers, back in about %1 h
IGUI_PD_VetRowTip_picked: They come back when the time runs out, unless the dog gets medicine or repellent first.
IGUI_PD_VetRowTip_boost: While it lasts, wounds don't get infected, bad food or dirty water don't upset the stomach, and the dog can't catch the flu.
IGUI_PD_VetSymptom_flu: Walks slower and needs to drink more water.
IGUI_PD_VetTodo_flu: Plenty of water, the fever comes with it. Antibiotics and the vaccine help.
IGUI_PD_VetSymptom_heartworm: Walks slowly, runs a fever, loses health and refuses orders.
IGUI_PD_VetTodo_heartworm: It drains health slowly and needs the heartworm medicine.
IGUI_PD_VetTodo_allergy: It passes on its own; the Companion Dogs allergy medicine makes it faster.
IGUI_PD_VetSymptom_fleas: Gets stressed, it can turn into an allergy.
IGUI_PD_VetSymptom_ticks: Gets stressed, it can turn into an allergy.
IGUI_PD_VetTodo_infest: It needs the Companion Dogs flea and tick medicine.
IGUI_PD_VetAllergicToTip: Every meal of %1 sets off an allergy flare. Avoid it; an antihistamine treats the flare and protects for a while afterwards.
IGUI_PD_VetInfestCured: %1 is free of fleas and ticks.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_Fracture_desc: Refuses to fight and cannot run.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_Fever_desc: Running hot, it needs plenty of water.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_Flu_desc: Walking slowly and needs plenty of water. Fever comes with it!
IGUI_PD_Moodle_Ticks_desc: It is stressing your pet out!
IGUI_PD_Moodle_Fleas_desc: It is stressing your pet out!
